findings.summary: Check 09's only PASS route is state-face HTTP GET /v1/takeover; the spec's MCP route ('经 MCP… R5 后为 state_takeover') is detected but never called — an MCP-only takeover face can never turn 09 green (permanent false red), and conversely an HTTP-only takeover face would PASS with no MCP probe at all (confirms continuous finding; latent, no false PASS in current R0 state)

Check 17 omits the criterion's first half ('名册线 MCP 工具集无 dd-mcp 入口', e.g. grep of $VRB_ROSTER line toolsets); only the rounds.jsonl half (dd.dispatch.v1/dd.gate_release.v1 present, no dd-mcp call records) is probed, so PASS is reachable while a dd-mcp entry could still exist in roster line toolsets (confirms continuous finding)

Check 16's sole PASS branch fires when the synthetic target line merely appears anywhere in state /v1/lines; neither '驻停未解除' (line still waiting_decision) nor '回执写明消息不是裁决' is actually verified though the evidence line asserts both — unreachable in R0 (line_message to a synthetic line is rejected → earlier honest FAIL), latent false-green afterwards

Check 06 executor direction verifies rejection of the synthetic acceptance mutation but not the required rejection 留痕 (only supervisor-direction contract_changed traces are searched) (confirms continuous finding)

Check 18's same-line grep (file-name hit and read pattern on one line) can miss two-line read-of-terminal.json/.scheduler patterns — false-green blind spot inherent to the spec-prescribed grep method (confirms continuous finding)

Check 02 counts the substring 'coord.' anywhere in the /v1/protocols body instead of only within kind fields — conservative direction (can only over-report FAIL, never PASS) (confirms continuous finding)

Check 07's seats-source half is weak: seats_source is only flagged when it is a JSON object whose values match cmdline/stage-model/override; a string-valued source (e.g. "cmdline") or a record with seats but no seats_source is not flagged. The primary cmdline --stage-model assertion is solid

Check 13 validates only shape (remote_ref refs/heads/release/ prefix, 40-char non-zero target_base_commit); 'base equals the release/<line-id> head at dispatch time' is not compared against any recorded dispatch-time head — a limitation of the record.json data source the spec names, not an added risk
